skills.description: Using a camera installed at the bathroom doorway (or inside the bathroom only detecting human silhouettes, without capturing private details), the system uses human detection and entry/exit tracking to identify when an elderly person enters or leaves the toilet and calculates the continuous occupancy time. Application scenarios: solo-living elder households, nursing homes, senior apartments. The system runs automatically; if the elderly stay in the toilet for more than 30 minutes without coming out, urgent reminders are pushed via app suggesting an on-site check. Skill features: sudden illness or falls during toileting that prevent the elderly from calling for help is a common safety risk. Automatic occupancy-time monitoring helps detect anomalies in time and gain rescue time.
